# P24.3 — Observability & alerting (OBS.1 / GL-OBS-01)

Spec: `docs/tickets/P24.3__observability-alerting.md` (Lane C, new code; no gate; offline-only;
`live_verification=false`). Requirement ids: **GL-OBS-01**. Decision: **ADR-077** · Risk:
**RISK-P24-02** · Deferral opened: **D-OBS.1-1** (live-side verification).

## Summary

Makes the live stack observable and self-alerting inside the zero-cost posture
(SIG-STORE-003) — a **file**, not a hosted metrics stack. The notifier seam is
*record-first, notify-second*: every alert appends to an append-only JSONL ledger
(`.sig/ops/alerts.jsonl`, env `SIG_ALERT_LOG`) before any external delivery, so the
deterministic artifact never depends on a network or a credential. Notifiers:
always-on `SIG-ALERT` log line + an **env-configured webhook**
(`SIG_ALERT_WEBHOOK_URL` / `SIG_ALERT_WEBHOOK_TOKEN`, HG-09 — no paid service, no
credential literals, the URL itself never logged).

INFRA.1's egress-budget alarm is **consumed, not re-implemented**: the breach
decision stays in `ops.egress.build_report` (unchanged); `sig-ops egress-report
--alert` fires a recorded alert on warn/alarm. Keepalive verification
(`observe.verify_keepalive` via `sig-ops keepalive-check`) checks the machinery
(workflow still carries `cron:` + `sig-ops degraded`) *and* the function (the
degraded rebuild really produces `web/dist`); a failure fires a recorded
`critical` alert, and `keepalive.yml` gains an `if: failure()` step that runs
`sig-ops alert`. Metrics = a bounded JSONL probe log (`sig-ops probe`, one
ok/latency row per service through the single `http_ok`/`pg_ready` the CLI's
`status`/`up` now reuse). Uptime + error budgets = `compute_uptime` over the
rolling `[observability]` window (`ops/config.toml`: `uptime_target_pct=99.0`,
`window_days=30`) — `no-data` when unmeasured, never a fabricated 100% (§3.1).
Bounded log retention = `prune_jsonl` age+byte caps on both logs. Secret hygiene
is structural: `scrub_secrets` masks env-secret *values* in every emitted
surface.

## What changed

- `ops/src/ops/alerts.py` — `Alert`, `AlertLedger` (append-only JSONL),
  `LogNotifier`/`WebhookNotifier`, `notifiers_from_env`, `fire`, `scrub_secrets`.
- `ops/src/ops/observe.py` — `http_ok`/`pg_ready` (single probe impl), `probe_stack`,
  `ProbeLog`, `RetentionPolicy`/`prune_jsonl`, `ObservabilityConfig`,
  `compute_uptime`, `verify_keepalive`, `render_dashboard`.
- `ops/src/ops/cli.py` — new verbs: `egress-report --alert`, `keepalive-check`,
  `probe [--alert]`, `alerts`, `alert`, `dashboard [--out]`; `status`/`up` reuse
  `observe.http_ok`/`pg_ready`.
- `ops/config.toml` — `[observability]` block (budgets + retention; notifier env
  documented, no literals).
- `.github/workflows/observability.yml` — daily egress check + probe (when
  endpoints configured) + readout + artifact upload.
- `.github/workflows/keepalive.yml` — `if: failure()` recorded alert + ledger upload.
- `docs/build/reports/observability-dashboard.md` — the committed readout artifact.
- `docs/adr/ADR-077-…md` + Appendix F row (`spec_src/99a_appF_adr.md`, spec rebuilt
  byte-identical via `BUILD.sh`) + regenerated `docs/adr/README.md`.
- `docs/risk_register.md` (RISK-P24-02), `docs/traceability.md`, `ops/README.md`,
  `ops/AGENTS.md`, `docs/tickets/DEFERRALS.md` (D-OBS.1-1).
- Tests: `tests/ops/test_alerts.py` + `tests/ops/test_observe.py` (31 new tests).
- Build memory: `docs/build/runs/P24.3.md`, `BUILD_INDEX.md` row 81, `LEDGER.md`
  advanced (`lastCompleted: P24.3`, `nextTicket: P24.4`, chainTip updated).

## Acceptance criteria → evidence

| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| egress-threshold breach fires a RECORDED alert | `test_egress_breach_fires_a_recorded_alert` (exit 5 + ledger row `kind=egress-budget severity=alarm`); `test_egress_warn_band_records_a_warn_alert`; negative: `test_egress_below_threshold_records_no_alert`, `test_egress_gate_pending_fires_no_false_alarm` |
| keepalive failure fires a RECORDED alert | `test_keepalive_failure_fires_a_recorded_alert` (exit 6 + ledger row `kind=keepalive severity=critical`); `test_verify_keepalive_reports_a_failed_rebuild`, `test_verify_keepalive_reports_a_missing_or_gutted_workflow`, `test_committed_keepalive_workflow_is_intact` |
| dashboard/readout exists; no secrets in logs | `test_cli_dashboard_writes_the_readout_file` + `test_render_dashboard_*`; committed artifact `docs/build/reports/observability-dashboard.md`; `test_no_env_secret_reaches_the_ledger_or_log`, `test_scrub_secrets_masks_env_secret_values`, `test_webhook_posts_scrubbed_json_and_never_logs_the_url` |
| metrics/logs + uptime/error budgets + bounded retention | `test_probe_stack_*`, `test_probe_log_*`, `test_compute_uptime_*` (within-budget / exhausted / no-data), `test_retention_*` (age cap, byte cap, no-op) |
| universal phase-gate AC | `SIG_REQUIRE_DB_TESTS=1 make check` green; ADR-077 + `## Revisit trigger`; Appendix F row (SIG-ENG-039); RISK-P24-02 + traceability; D-OBS.1-1 DEFERRALS row; BUILD_INDEX row 81 + LEDGER advanced |

## Verification

- `SIG_REQUIRE_DB_TESTS=1 make check` (Docker up, PG18+PostGIS) → **2849 passed,
  2 skipped, 0 failed, 0 xfailed** (~79 s); ruff + `ruff format --check` clean;
  mypy 220 source files clean; `verify-gen` byte-clean.
- `uv run pytest tests/ops -q` → **65 passed** (34 baseline + 31 new).
- `make docs-check` → exit 0 (1 pre-existing BM-ADR-04 warning, not a violation).
- `bash scripts/docs/check-build-memory.sh .` → exit 0.
- `uv run python docs/build/tools/check_spec_src.py` → exit 0 (**76 ADRs**,
  byte-identical spec reproduction, Appendix F == `docs/adr/` file set).
- Live smoke (operator surface): `sig-ops egress-report --usage-gb 120 --alert` →
  exit 5 + a recorded `alarm` alert; `sig-ops dashboard --verify-keepalive --out
  docs/build/reports/observability-dashboard.md` → keepalive **OK** (real degraded
  `npm run build` produced `web/dist`); `sig-ops alerts` lists the ledger.
- No secret/token literal (`tests/connectors/test_secrets.py` green; env-only).

## Deferrals

- **D-OBS.1-1 (OPEN, kind V)** — real webhook delivery + first real probe/uptime
  data against the hosted stack; needs HG-12 endpoints (+ optional
  `SIG_ALERT_WEBHOOK_URL`). Compensating control: recorded-alert ledger fires with
  no notifier configured; webhook POST proven by stubbed transport; `no-data`
  until real probes land.

## Out of scope (confirmed)

Hosting substrate (DEPLOY.1 — `ops/gcp/` untouched); scheduling itself (SCHED.1 —
`reingest.yml` untouched); the egress alarm's creation (INFRA.1 — `ops/egress.py`
unchanged, consumed). No client JS on public pages; no UPDATE/DELETE on the claim
spine (ledgers are append-only JSONL under gitignored `.sig/`).
